reason: TypeScript defect, reported 2026-11-12, fix pending on main. spliceExtLst of redaction-xml.ts puts the redaction mark into an existing a:extLst with String.prototype.replace and a replacement string holding the label, so `$$`, `$&`, `$'` and `$`` in a label are expanded: the label loses text or takes in markup. Rust writes the escaped label as it is.

TypeScript defect, reported 2026-11-12, fix pending on main. ensureCreationId finds the extension list of p:cNvPr only as the literal `</a:extLst>`, so for a self-closing `<a:extLst/>` or a closing tag with white space it appends a second a:extLst, which CT_NonVisualDrawingProps does not allow. Rust adds the extension to the list that is there.

TypeScript defect, reported 2026-11-12, fix pending on main. patchCellsTcPr (table-edit.ts:429) gives a cell without a:tcPr its properties with a replacement string, so `$&`, `$$`, `$'` and `$`` in a shading or border color that is not a color are expanded into markup. Rust writes the value as given.

typescript.error: SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /<p:cNvPr\b[^>]*\bid="("[^>]*?(\/?)>/: Unterminated group

reason: TypeScript defect, reported 2026-11-12, fix pending on main. stripRedactExt (redaction-xml.ts:129) writes a list that still holds something back as `<a:extLst>inner</a:extLst>`, without its attributes, so a namespace declared there is lost and the content left unbound. Rust keeps the list as it is.

TypeScript defect, reported 2026-11-12, fix pending on main. OUR_EXT_RE (redaction-xml.ts:118) reads a self-closing extension of ours followed by another extension as one match through that one's `</a:ext>`, so stripping or replacing our mark deletes the neighbour. Rust matches the self-closing tag alone.

Rust answers for the table's own names only: no color.

Rust answers for the map's own alignments only.
